arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Olson argued the primary process discouraged qualified candidates.
Mr. Olson claimed the process spawned expensive and corrupting fundraising.
Mr. Rossman stated the signature requirement was no barrier to participation.
Mr. Schwarz argued the district court found severe burdens on insurgents.
